name: sae-audio
title: SAE sound-capture probe (test tool, never shipped)
author: Liam Stannard
description: Loaded only by tools/client/audio/capture.py through tools/client/launch.sh. Builds one working machine on a planet's own surface, holds the camera on it at a fixed zoom with the GUI hidden, and fires sync markers (a flash and a click on one tick) before it starts, so its sound can be recorded against its picture.
